name: email_breaches
description: Check whether an email address appears in known data breaches. Free lookup, no key: returns the list of breach names the address was found in (e.g. LinkedIn, Adobe), or breached=false. For per-breach detail — what data was exposed, dates, risk score — follow up with email_breach_analytics.

name: email_breach_analytics
description: Detailed breach-exposure report for an email address: every breach it appears in with breach date, records affected and which data classes leaked (passwords, phone numbers, addresses), plus an overall risk score/label, password-strength breakdown and paste exposures. Free, no key.
